briefdescription.para: Number of bytes of arguments this function has on the stack.

detaileddescription.para: If the callee is expected to restore the argument stack this should be a multiple of 16, all usable during a tail call.

The alternative would forbid tail call optimisation in some cases: if we want to transfer control from a function with 8-bytes of stack-argument space to a function with 16-bytes then misalignment of this value would make a stack adjustment necessary, which could not be undone by the callee.

briefdescription.para: The number of bytes to restore to deallocate space for incoming arguments.

detaileddescription.para: Canonically 0 in the C calling convention, but non-zero when callee is expected to pop the args.

briefdescription.para: Space just below incoming stack pointer reserved for arguments being passed on the stack during a tail call.

detaileddescription.para: This will be the difference between the largest tail call argument space needed in this function and what's already available by reusing space of incoming arguments.

The stack slots used to add space between FPR and GPR accesses when using hazard padding.

detaileddescription.para: StackHazardCSRSlotIndex is added between GPR and FPR CSRs. StackHazardSlotIndex is added between (sorted) stack objects.

briefdescription.para: True if this function has a subset of CSRs that is handled explicitly via copies.

HasCalculatedStackSizeSVE indicates whether StackSizeSVE is valid.

detaileddescription.para: Initialized during frame lowering, unless the function has the noredzone attribute, in which case it is set to false at construction.

briefdescription.para: ForwardedMustTailRegParms - A list of virtual and physical registers that must be forwarded to every musttail call.

briefdescription.para: SignReturnAddress is true if PAC-RET is enabled for the function with defaults being sign non-leaf functions only, with the B key.
SignReturnAddressAll modifies the default PAC-RET mode to signing leaf functions as well.
SignWithBKey modifies the default PAC-RET mode to signing with the B key.
HasELFSignedGOT is true if the target binary format is ELF and the IR module containing the corresponding function has "ptrauth-elf-got" flag set to 1.
SigningInstrOffset captures the offset of the PAC-RET signing instruction within the prologue, so it can be re-used for authentication in the epilogue when using PC as a second salt (FEAT_PAuth_LR)
BranchTargetEnforcement enables placing BTI instructions at potential indirect branch destinations.
Indicates that SP signing should be diversified with PC as-per PAuthLR.

detaileddescription.para: This is set by -mbranch-protection and will emit NOP instructions unless the subtarget feature +pauthlr is also used (in which case non-NOP instructions are emitted).

briefdescription.para: Whether this function has an extended frame record [Ctx, FP, LR].

detaileddescription.para: If so, bit 60 of the in-memory FP will be 1 to enable other tools to detect the extended record.
